question: Who makes Indulgeo Essentials avocado oil
markdown:

is an Indian natural skin and hair care brand founded in 2016 by
Supriya Malik
under the guidance of her mother, Seema Arora. They source their pure, cold-pressed avocado oil from certified organic oil vendors and package it under their own homegrown label.
